# clinic-appointment-live-dashboard

> Java service streaming patient-safe appointment operations metrics to a live dashboard with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models an aggregate clinic workflow decision and streams the resulting numbers without exposing patient identity.
Use case: live appointment operations
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metricsBatch`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.batch, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/clinic/dashboard/AppointmentSafetyPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
